AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  MARCH 5, 2019
REGULAR MEETING
  6:15 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  REVISED
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS
 CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  §54956.8: Assessor Parcel Number 8082-013-905; Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus Gomez,
  City Manager; Negotiating Party: Department of the Air Force; Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of
  Payment.

  II.  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957.6; CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR -
  Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez; regarding negotiations with the Norwalk
  Association of Management Employees.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

INVOCATION
  April Reutter
  Pray Norwalk

FLAG SALUTE
  Alyson Iribe, 5th grade
  Paddison Elementary School

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS

  I.  City Council to recognize Hometown Heroes from the City of Norwalk.

  II.  City Council to recognize the Norwalk-Santa Fe Springs Youth Football & Cheer League for their recent
  accomplishments.

  III.  City Council to recognize the Transportation Department Distinguished Coach Operators of the Year.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  Recap of Mayor’s Prayer Breakfast.

  2.  Recap of the State of the City Address.

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meeting of
  February 19, 2019. 825-04

  Minutes
   2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period January 27 –
  February 9, 2019, in the total amount of $910,228.34. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  February 13 - February 26, 2019, in the total amount of $3,092,676.53. 640

  Report

  4.  CLAIMS AGAINST THE CITY – Staff recommends City Council deny the claims filed by Robert Prieto
  and Christine and Robert Schaper. 830-16/19

  Report

  5.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS – FEBRUARY 27, 2019 - No action is required unless the City
  Council elects to review the decision of the Planning Commission on those items where the
  Commission’s action was final. 320

  Report

  6.  RESOLUTION NO. 19-04 - DESTRUCTION OF OBSOLETE RECORDS – Staff recommends City
  Council adopt Resolution No. 19-04, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING THE DESTRUCTION OF CERTAIN RECORDS IN THE COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT, HUMAN RESOURCES, PUBLIC SAFETY, AND PUBLIC SERVICES
  DEPARTMENTS. 870-02

  Report

  7.  RESOLUTION NO. 19-08 - SUPPORTING THE CITY OF PARAMOUNT’S DESIRE TO JOIN THE
  SOUTHEAST LOS ANGELES COUNTY WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT BOARD – Staff recommends
  City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-08, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR THE CITY OF PARAMOUNT’S DESIRE TO JOIN THE
  SOUTHEAST LOS ANGELES COUNTY WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT BOARD. 135-15-02

  Report

  8.  AGREEMENT - CONSULTING SERVICES FOR THE 2020 CENSUS CAMPAIGN – Staff recommends
  City Council approve an agreement with Salvador Flores to provide consulting services for the 2020
  Census in the amount of $30,000 from March 5, 2019 to March 31, 2020; and authorize the City
  Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments provided there is funding in the budget, on
  behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 636-01

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  9.  ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

REPORTS

  10. AGREEMENT - BUS PAINTING AND DECALING SERVICES - Staff recommends City Council
  approve an agreement with A and A Fleet Painting, Inc. for bus painting and decaling buses in the
  amount of $85,358.31 during Fiscal Years 2018/19 and 2019/20; and authorize the City Manager to
  execute the agreement, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 634-03

  Report

  11. AGREEMENT - FAREBOX EQUIPMENT UPGRADE FOR TRANSIT ACCESS PASS - Staff
  recommends City Council approve an agreement with Cubic Transportation Systems, Inc. for
   acquisition and installation of Transit Access Pass farebox upgrade equipment in the amount of
  $503,409, as a sole source procurement for this project; and authorize the City Manager to execute the
  agreement and any other amendments provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in
  a form approved by the City Attorney. 634-03

  Report

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated February 28, 2019.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
